sysinfo.notes: SysInfo v2.3 by WHiZ/eQUiNOX, the board's I command. Boxed system information over four panes. ZERO narrow marks and zero unmapped glyphs at 40. Its node row is what the stat rung was written for - 'Init Baud is: 115200 Baud' and 'Sysop Status: Busy at the Moment!' used to reach a caller as 'Init Baud is: >' and 'Sysop Status: B>' - and its three single-column panes are what the prose rung was written for ('Software Running: Kickstart 40.68 Workb>' lost the Workbench version). The capture answers the first pause with n, so the LAST frame is the door's own information screen rather than its exit line. Marked C64_ADAPT=40 on 2026-09-06.

games.harness: printf '%s\n' '4000 \r' '8000 \r' '12000 q\r' | env BBS_DATA_DIR=$REPO npx tsx src/scripts/run-amiga-door.ts $REPO/Doors/5D-AdiMenu/5D-AdiMenu 1 --doortype XIM --command games --timeout 25 > games.ans
games.notes: 5D-AdiMenu V1.0 by tHE aDDiCT/5D!, the board's games command: a header, the BBSLINK online-games menu shown through JH_SF, and a footer. All THIRTY [CODE] Name entries reach a 40-column caller, with ZERO narrow marks and zero unmapped glyphs - the record rung places each entry's right-hand code flush against column 40 instead of spending a second row on it, which is what took the menu from 33 painted rows to 24 and let it fit one page with its title. The door sends JH_SF with data 0, so it does NOT force non-stop and the board's pause is free to arm; it simply is not needed for this menu any more. Marked C64_ADAPT=40 on 2026-09-06.

olm.harness: printf '%s\n' '4000 \r' '8000 \r' '12000 q\r' | env BBS_DATA_DIR=$REPO npx tsx src/scripts/run-amiga-door.ts $REPO/Doors/!!!WAR!!!/WAROLM/WAROLM 1 --doortype XIM --command Olm --timeout 25 > olm.ans
olm.notes: WarOLM V0.3 by Wardancer/Vanity, the board's Olm command: a four-row node table inside a box, with a cursor-key help line under it. Zero unmapped glyphs at 40 and every node record whole - number, user, location and action. THREE narrow marks remain and none of them is on data: the door's own title/credits row, and the '=' runs that pad an absent node's empty USER and LOCATION cells on the two node-00 variants (plain and selected). Those two rows are the ones that forced narrowRow to spend decoration before content: widest-first put the truncation mark inside the ACTION field and the caller read 'No Node Present' as 'No Node Pre>'. The help line is the prose rung's - 'Use Cursor Keys To Choose, <-' Enter To>' no longer says how to quit. Marked C64_ADAPT=40 on 2026-09-06.
